items.description: Tired of mining all that ore by yourself? Well now you don't have to with the Auto-Miner Collectron!
You'll never go thirsty with Biv Bev here to serve!
Come collect Corn and various other types of items with the Cobby Collectron Station!
Embrace great American lumber with your own Lumberjack Collectron.
Put your C.A.M.P. to work with the trusty Mr. Farmhand Collectron.
Having a bad day? Have a Nuka-Cola! Don't have any Nuka-Cola? Let this Collectron find some for you!
Take the leap... Enjoy a Quantum! Don't have any Nuka-Cola Quantum? Let this Collectron find some for you!
A good Scout understands the elements and knows how to best harvest from mother nature. Allow the Scoutmaster Collectron to lead by example!
The Silver Collectron is polished and ready to serve!
Let this collectron gather some of that toxic stuff you'd rather not touch.
